sys.setrecursionlimit(10**7)

INF_VAL = 10**18

def get_min_moves(n):
    global cache_dp
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    if n < len(cache_dp) and cache_dp[n]:
        return cache_dp[n]
    prev_diff = INF_VAL
    x = 1
    steps_count = 0
    while abs(x - n) <= prev_diff:
        prev_diff = abs(x - n)
        x = x * 10 + 1
        steps_count += 1
    x //= 10
    if x > n and x // 10:
        if n < len(cache_dp):
            return min(steps_count + get_min_moves(abs(x - n)),
                       steps_count - 1 + get_min_moves(abs(x // 10 - n)))
        return min(steps_count + get_min_moves(abs(x - n)),
                   steps_count - 1 + get_min_moves(abs(x // 10 - n)))
    if n < len(cache_dp):
        return steps_count + get_min_moves(abs(x - n))
    return steps_count + get_min_moves(abs(x - n))

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.read())
    global cache_dp
    cache_dp = [0] * int(1e7)
    print(get_min_moves(n))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
